account_self_service.condition: Actual authenticated identity/subject; correct provider/global-self versus company-specific profile context; available during approved pending/PT/trial/member/vendor/staff self-service without requiring active paid membership
account_self_service.scope: own safe profile/preferences/security/inbox only, not company role fields, other people, financial/HR administration or another tenant
account_self_service.field_guards: Only permitted self-editable name/avatar/contact/preferences. Global verified-email/password/factor changes use actual provider identity proof, not a company profile edit. Company-private facts and issued snapshots remain independent.

assigned_staff_self_service.condition: Actual own current employment/onboarding assignment, applicable source requirement or issued-to-subject record; not merely job-title role and not rental coach without separate employment
assigned_staff_self_service.scope: own issued contract/payslip, own assigned SOP, own shifts/availability/leave/time evidence only; no other employee/disciplinary/payroll approval
assigned_staff_self_service.before_activation: Applicable intended-subject contract/SOP/evidence tasks reachable during bounded staff onboarding; full operational employment/role privileges not activated by these rights
assigned_staff_self_service.after_leaving: Only explicitly permitted retained-history/issued-recipient access and account resolution remain; no new shift/leave/time actions from archived employment by default

override_and_source_guards: Role templates are editable starting defaults. Company-scoped individual denies and actual account/source restrictions still apply; company role restrictions cannot become global identity takeover or block another company context. Actual source safety/assurance/recipient/field/retention rules always apply. Required provider recovery/resolution routes keep their separately verified minimum boundary.
not_a_role_escalation: These self-scoped rules never grant owner/manager/member entitlement, qualification, source approval or broad document/HR access. Owner can configure permitted exceptions through current granular controls.
